title: tx_queue_stats_get lacks lock despite API promising thread-safety
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 428

Header (line 206-208) states 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation (lines 416-430) never calls lock_queue(). The code comment at line 426 directly contradicts the API documentation. Callers relying on documented thread-safety will experience torn reads during concurrent writes.
close_reason: Already fixed - implementation at lines 426-428 correctly uses lock_queue()/unlock_queue() for thread-safe stats copy
